{{short description|Finnish mathematical statistician (born 1950)}}
'''Hannu Frans Vilhelm Oja''' (born December 17, 1950, in [[Jämsä]]) is a Finnish mathematical statistician and biostatistician known for his contribution to [[nonparametric inference]], [[robust statistics]], and [[Multivariate statistics|multivariate statistical methods]].<ref name=IEEE /><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Nordhausen |first1=Klaus |last2=Oja |first2=Hannu |date=2018-03-07 |title=Robust Nonparametric Inference |url=https://www.annualreviews.org/doi/10.1146/annurev-statistics-031017-100247 |journal=Annual Review of Statistics and Its Application |language=en |volume=5 |issue=1 |pages=473–500 |doi=10.1146/annurev-statistics-031017-100247 |bibcode=2018AnRSA...5..473N |issn=2326-8298|url-access=subscription }}</ref> He introduced the [[Oja median]] for [[multivariate distribution]]s.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Fischer |first1=Daniel |last2=Mosler |first2=Karl |last3=Möttönen |first3=Jyrki |last4=Nordhausen |first4=Klaus |last5=Pokotylo |first5=Oleksii |last6=Vogel |first6=Daniel |date=2020 |title=Computing the Oja Median in R : The Package OjaNP |url=http://www.jstatsoft.org/v92/i08/ |journal=Journal of Statistical Software |language=en |volume=92 |issue=8 |doi=10.18637/jss.v092.i08 |s2cid=88515541 |issn=1548-7660|doi-access=free |hdl=10138/325096 |hdl-access=free |arxiv=1606.07620 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Oja |first=Hannu |date=1983 |title=Descriptive statistics for multivariate distributions |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/0167715283900548 |journal=Statistics & Probability Letters |language=en |volume=1 |issue=6 |pages=327–332 |doi=10.1016/0167-7152(83)90054-8|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Citation |last=Oja |first=Hannu |chapter=Multivariate Median |date=2013 |chapter-url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-3-642-35494-6_1 |title=Robustness and Complex Data Structures |pages=3–15 |editor-last=Becker |editor-first=Claudia |place=Berlin, Heidelberg |publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-642-35494-6_1 |isbn=978-3-642-35493-9 |access-date=2022-12-18 |editor2-last=Fried |editor2-first=Roland |editor3-last=Kuhnt == Education and career ==
Oja was born in [[Jämsä]] and studied in high school in Tampere (''Tampereen klassillinen lyseo''). He received his MSc in statistics at the [[University of Tampere]] in 1973 and his doctorate in 1981 at the [[University of Oulu]] under the supervision of [[Elja Arjas]].<ref>{{Citation |last=Arjas |first=Elja |chapter=When We Were Very Young: Some Recollections from Hannu Oja's First Years of Academic Life |date=2015 |chapter-url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-3-319-22404-6_1 |title=Modern Nonparametric, Robust and Multivariate Methods |pages=3–6 |editor-last=Nordhausen |editor-first=Klaus |place=Cham |publisher=Springer International Publishing |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-319-22404-6_1 |isbn=978-3-319-22403-9 |access-date=2022-12-18 |editor2-last=Taskinen |editor2-first=Sara|chapter-url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Oja |first=Hannu |date=1981 |title=On Location, Scale, Skewness and Kurtosis of Univariate Distributions |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/4615828 |journal=Scandinavian Journal of Statistics |volume=8 |issue=3 |pages=154–168 |jstor=4615828 |issn=0303-6898}}</ref> Oja stayed on at the [[University of Oulu]] as a lecturer after his PhD. He later moved to [[Jyväskylä University]]. He was professor of [[biometrics]] at [[University of Tampere]]'s Department of Health Sciences and an academy professor at the university from 2008 to 2012. He's current a professor in mathematics at [[University of Turku]].<ref name=IEEE>{{Cite web |url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/37443142100 |access-date=2022-12-18 |title=Hannu Oja}}</ref>

Oja has done research especially in the field of nonparametric statistical methods. He has also conducted applied statistical research in the fields of biometrics, signal processing, machine learning, and nutrition and health sciences. Oja became a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 2009.
